	FROM DAT
	LEFT JOIN EDS.TRU_AUMNONUITF AUMNONUITF ON DAT.AS_OF_DATE = AUMNONUITF.AS_OF_DATE
	)
	,TRU_INVEST
AS (
	SELECT 
		 DISTINCT
		 DAT.AS_OF_DATE AS_OF_DATE
		,CUST.UNIQUE_ID CIF_ID
		,CUST.CUST_NO INTE_CIF_ID
		,BASE.CUST_NO BASE_NO
		,BASE.CUST_NO_UNMASKED BASE_NO_UNMASKED
		,BASE.LAST6_CUST_NO LAST6_BASE_NO
		,BASE.PRIMARY_FLAG
		,PORT.PORTFOLIO_NO
		,PORT.PORTFOLIO_NO_UNMASKED
		,PORT.SUBSCRIPTION_ID
		,SUBS.INCEPTION_DATE
		,SEC.MATURITY_DATE
		,CASE 
			WHEN PORT.PROD_CODE = 'TUTF'
				THEN 'UITF'
			WHEN PORT.PROD_CODE <> 'TUTF'
				THEN 'NONUITF'
			END PRODUCT_GROUP
		,CASE 
			WHEN PORT.PROD_CODE = 'TUTF'
				THEN UITFPF.FUND_CD
			WHEN PORT.PROD_CODE <> 'TUTF'
				THEN PORT.PROD_CODE
			END PRODUCT_CODE
		,CASE 
			WHEN PORT.PROD_CODE = 'TUTF'
				THEN UITF.BALANCE_UNITS
			ELSE NONUITF.NONUITF_HOLDING_UNITS
			END HOLDING_UNITS
		,CASE 
			WHEN PORT.PROD_CODE = 'TUTF'
				THEN UITF.FUND_CURRENCY_CODE
			ELSE NONUITF.NONUITF_INVESTMENT_CCY
			END PRINCIPAL_VALUE_CCY
		,CON.CONVERSIONRATE
		,CASE 
			WHEN PORT.PROD_CODE = 'TUTF'
				THEN UITF.INVESTMENT_VALUE
			ELSE NONUITF.NONUITF_INVESTMENT_AMT
			END PRINCIPAL_VALUE_ORIG
		,CASE 
			WHEN PORT.PROD_CODE = 'TUTF'
				THEN COALESCE(COALESCE(UITF.INVESTMENT_VALUE,0) * (
							CASE 
								WHEN UITF.FUND_CURRENCY_CODE = 'PHP'
									THEN 1
								ELSE COALESCE(CON.CONVERSIONRATE,0)
								END
							), 0)
			ELSE COALESCE(NONUITF.NONUITF_INVESTMENT_AMT,0) * (
						CASE 
							WHEN NONUITF.NONUITF_INVESTMENT_CCY = 'PHP'
								THEN 1
							ELSE COALESCE(CON.CONVERSIONRATE,0)
							END
						)
			END PRINCIPAL_VALUE_PHP
		,CASE 
			WHEN PORT.PROD_CODE = 'TUTF'
				THEN UITF.MARKET_VALUE
			ELSE NONUITF.NONUITF_CURRENT_VALUE
			END MARKET_VALUE_ORIG
		,CASE 
			WHEN PORT.PROD_CODE = 'TUTF'
				THEN COALESCE(UITF.MARKET_VALUE,0) * (
							CASE 
								WHEN UITF.FUND_CURRENCY_CODE = 'PHP'
									THEN 1
								ELSE COALESCE(CON.CONVERSIONRATE,0)
								END
							)
			ELSE COALESCE(NONUITF.NONUITF_CURRENT_VALUE,0) * (
						CASE 
							WHEN NONUITF.NONUITF_INVESTMENT_CCY = 'PHP'
								THEN 1
							ELSE COALESCE(CON.CONVERSIONRATE,0)
							END
						)
			END MARKET_VALUE_PHP
		,CASE 
			WHEN PORT.PROD_CODE = 'TUTF'
				THEN UITF.GAIN_LOSS
			ELSE (
					CASE 
						WHEN NONUITF.NONUITF_SUB_PROD_CODE IN (
								'BONDS'
								,'TB'
								,'GS'
								,'STCP'
								,'CERT'
								,'CS'
								,'PN'
								,'SCR'
								,'RE'
								,'RS'
								,'CHATTEL'
								,'PP'
								)
							THEN ((COALESCE(NONUITF.NONUITF_HOLDING_UNITS,0) * COALESCE(NONUITF.NONUITF_SEC_PRICE,0) / 100) - (COALESCE(NONUITF.NONUITF_HOLDING_UNITS,0) * COALESCE(NONUITF.NONUITF_AVG_PRICE,0) / 100))
						WHEN NONUITF.NONUITF_SUB_PROD_CODE IN (
								'CA'
								,'SA'
								)
							THEN 0
						ELSE ((COALESCE(NONUITF.NONUITF_HOLDING_UNITS,0) * COALESCE(NONUITF.NONUITF_SEC_PRICE,0)) - (COALESCE(NONUITF.NONUITF_HOLDING_UNITS,0) * COALESCE(NONUITF.NONUITF_AVG_PRICE,0)))
						END
					)
			END GAIN_LOSS_ORIG
		,CASE 
			WHEN PORT.PROD_CODE = 'TUTF'
				THEN COALESCE(UITF.GAIN_LOSS,0) * (
							CASE 
								WHEN UITF.FUND_CURRENCY_CODE = 'PHP'
									THEN 1
								ELSE COALESCE(CON.CONVERSIONRATE,0)
								END
							)
			ELSE (
						(
							CASE 
								WHEN NONUITF.NONUITF_SUB_PROD_CODE IN (
										'BONDS'
										,'TB'
										,'GS'
										,'STCP'
										,'CERT'
										,'CS'
										,'PN'
										,'SCR'
										,'RE'
										,'RS'
										,'CHATTEL'
										,'PP'
										)
									THEN ((COALESCE(NONUITF.NONUITF_HOLDING_UNITS,0) * COALESCE(NONUITF.NONUITF_SEC_PRICE,0) / 100) - (COALESCE(NONUITF.NONUITF_HOLDING_UNITS,0) * COALESCE(NONUITF.NONUITF_AVG_PRICE,0) / 100))
								WHEN NONUITF.NONUITF_SUB_PROD_CODE IN (
										'CA'
										,'SA'
										)
									THEN 0
								ELSE ((COALESCE(NONUITF.NONUITF_HOLDING_UNITS,0) * COALESCE(NONUITF.NONUITF_SEC_PRICE,0)) - (COALESCE(NONUITF.NONUITF_HOLDING_UNITS,0) * COALESCE(NONUITF.NONUITF_AVG_PRICE,0)))
								END
							)
						) * (
						CASE 
							WHEN NONUITF.NONUITF_INVESTMENT_CCY = 'PHP'
								THEN 1
							ELSE COALESCE(CON.CONVERSIONRATE,0)
							END
						)
			END GAIN_LOSS_PHP
		,CASE 
			WHEN PORT.PROD_CODE = 'TUTF'
				THEN COALESCE(UITF.ROI, 0)
			ELSE COALESCE(CASE 
						WHEN NONUITF.NONUITF_SUB_PROD_CODE IN (
								'BONDS'
								,'TB'
								,'GS'
								,'STCP'
								,'CERT'
								,'CS'
								,'PN'
								,'SCR'
								,'RE'
								,'RS'
								,'CHATTEL'
								,'PP'
								)
							THEN
								/* ROI = (P - A) / A, with prices quoted per 100 */
								((COALESCE(NONUITF.NONUITF_HOLDING_UNITS,0) * COALESCE(NONUITF.NONUITF_SEC_PRICE,0) / 100.0) - (COALESCE(NONUITF.NONUITF_HOLDING_UNITS,0) * COALESCE(NONUITF.NONUITF_AVG_PRICE,0) / 100.0)) / NULLIF((COALESCE(NONUITF.NONUITF_HOLDING_UNITS,0) * COALESCE(NONUITF.NONUITF_AVG_PRICE,0) / 100.0), 0)
						WHEN NONUITF.NONUITF_SUB_PROD_CODE IN (
								'CA'
								,'SA'
								)
							THEN 0
						ELSE
							/* ROI = (P - A) / A for instruments quoted per 1 */
							((COALESCE(NONUITF.NONUITF_HOLDING_UNITS,0) * COALESCE(NONUITF.NONUITF_SEC_PRICE,0)) - (COALESCE(NONUITF.NONUITF_HOLDING_UNITS,0) * COALESCE(NONUITF.NONUITF_AVG_PRICE,0))) / NULLIF((COALESCE(NONUITF.NONUITF_HOLDING_UNITS,0) * COALESCE(NONUITF.NONUITF_AVG_PRICE,0)), 0)
						END, 0)
			END ROI
		,CUST.SUB_BR_CD CUST_SUB_BR_CD
		,CUST.RM_ID CUST_RM_ID
		,CUST.ADVISOR_ID CUST_ADVISOR_ID
		,CUST.REF_UNIT CUST_REF_UNIT
		,BASE.STATUS BASE_STATUS
		,BASE.AUTH_DT BASE_AUTH_DT
		,BASE.AUTH_ID BASE_AUTH_ID
		,BASE.MAKER_DT BASE_MAKER_DT
		,BASE.MAKER_ID BASE_MAKER_ID
		,SUBSCRIPTION_NAME SUBS_SUBSCRIPTION_NAME
		,PURPOSE SUBS_PURPOSE
		,MARKETING_OFFICER SUBS_MARKETING_OFFICER
		,SUBS.STATUS SUBS_STATUS
		,PAYMENT_TYPE SUBS_PAYMENT_TYPE
		,RC_DIVISION SUBS_RC_DIVISION
		,REFERRED_BY SUBS_REFERRED_BY
		,SUBS.REVIEW_DATE SUBS_REVIEW_DATE
		,DISPOSITIVE_PROVISION SUBS_DISPOSITIVE_PROVISION
		,TBG_REFERRAL SUBS_TBG_REFERRAL
		,FEE_SERVICE SUBS_FEE_SERVICE
		,SUBS.MAKER_ID SUBS_MAKER_ID
		,SUBS.MAKER_DATE SUBS_MAKER_DATE
		,SUBS.AUTH_ID SUBS_AUTH_ID
		,SUBS.AUTH_DATE SUBS_AUTH_DATE
		,REJECT_REASON SUBS_REJECT_REASON

		,MANDATE SUBS_MANDATE
		,IS_BLACKLISTED SUBS_IS_BLACKLISTED

	FROM DAT
	LEFT JOIN EDS.TRU_CUST CUST ON DAT.AS_OF_DATE BETWEEN CUST.SCD_START_DATE
			AND CUST.SCD_END_DATE
	LEFT JOIN EDS.TRU_BASELINK BASE ON CUST.CUST_NO = BASE.CIF_NO
		AND CUST.BNK_CODE = BASE.BNK_CODE
		AND DAT.AS_OF_DATE BETWEEN BASE.SCD_START_DATE
			AND BASE.SCD_END_DATE
	LEFT JOIN EDS.TRU_PORTFOLIO PORT ON BASE.CUST_NO = PORT.BASE_NO
		AND BASE.BNK_CODE = PORT.BNK_CODE
		AND DAT.AS_OF_DATE BETWEEN PORT.SCD_START_DATE
			AND PORT.SCD_END_DATE
	LEFT JOIN EDS.TRU_PFSUBSCRIPTION SUBS ON PORT.BASE_NO = SUBS.BASE_NO
		AND PORT.SUBSCRIPTION_ID = SUBS.SUBSCRIPTION_ID
		AND DAT.AS_OF_DATE BETWEEN SUBS.SCD_START_DATE
			AND SUBS.SCD_END_DATE
	LEFT JOIN NONUITF ON PORT.BASE_NO = NONUITF.NONUITF_BASE_NO
		AND PORT.PORTFOLIO_NO = NONUITF.NONUITF_PF_NO
		AND PORT.BNK_CODE = NONUITF.NONUITF_BNK_CODE
		AND DAT.AS_OF_DATE = NONUITF.AS_OF_DATE
	LEFT JOIN EDS.TRU_AUMUITF UITF ON PORT.BASE_NO = UITF.BASE_NO
		AND PORT.ACC_NO = UITF.PORTFOLIO_NO
		AND PORT.BNK_CODE = UITF.BNK_CODE
		AND DAT.AS_OF_DATE = UITF.AS_OF_DATE
	LEFT JOIN EDS.TRU_UITFPF UITFPF ON UITF.FUND_CODE = UITFPF.FUND_CD
		AND UITF.BNK_CODE = UITFPF.BNK_CODE
		AND DAT.AS_OF_DATE BETWEEN UITFPF.SCD_START_DATE
			AND UITFPF.SCD_END_DATE
	LEFT JOIN EDS.TRU_NONUITFSEC SEC ON NONUITF.NONUITF_SCHEME_CODE COLLATE Latin1_General_CS_AS = SEC.SEC_IDENTIFIER COLLATE Latin1_General_CS_AS
		AND DAT.AS_OF_DATE BETWEEN SEC.SCD_START_DATE
			AND SEC.SCD_END_DATE
	LEFT JOIN (
		SELECT CONVERTFROMCURRENCYID
			,CAST(CURRENCYCONVERSIONTIMESTAMP AS DATE) AS_OF_DATE
			,CONVERSIONRATE
		FROM BNKM.CURRENCYCONVERSION
		WHERE CONVERTTOCURRENCYID = 'PHP'
			AND FinancialInstitutionId = 'CBC01'
		) CON ON (
			CASE 
				WHEN PORT.PROD_CODE = 'TUTF'
					THEN UITF.FUND_CURRENCY_CODE
				ELSE NONUITF.NONUITF_INVESTMENT_CCY
				END
			) = CON.CONVERTFROMCURRENCYID
		AND DAT.AS_OF_DATE = CON.AS_OF_DATE
	WHERE PORT.STATUS = 'A'
	)
